scripts.//cf: Binding-realistic dev loop. Port 8788 is the base URL the seeding script defaults to. --persist-to pins ONE local state dir so dev, the CLI and the seeder all address the same D1/R2.
scripts.dev:cf:setup: wrangler d1 migrations apply img-gallery --local --persist-to .wrangler/state && pnpm build
scripts.dev:cf: pnpm dev:cf:setup && concurrently --names 'wrangler,watch' --kill-others 'wrangler dev --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/state' "chokidar 'pages/**/*.tsx' 'components/**/*.tsx' 'layouts/**/*.tsx' 'lib/**/*.ts' 'styles/**/*.css' --command 'pnpm build' --initial false --debounce 200"
